note: v3297: Four readers, one defect shape, all measured against a guest board that is structurally JOURNAL-RICH AND LEDGER-EMPTY: every durable what-was-DONE store is gitignored while the journal SEED is tracked, so a fresh clone inherits his testimony about what HAPPENED and has no record of what was DONE. Each reader coerced that absence into 0 and reported a defect that did not exist. The absent capture ledger manufactured journal-says-56 ledger-says-0 where the 56 was HIS imported journal. The printer-reach doctor discarded upstreams own state UNKNOWN and re-manufactured the populated-case confession. The sweep verdict was never joined to gate_failures so a dead OCR toolchain and a shelf with no stash panels printed the identical sentence. Route-lane runs-zero conflated stood-down-by-design, process-younger-than-the-tick, and a tick that raises upstream of the counter for ever.
